book: Muhamedis Alfragani Arabis chronologica et astronomica elementa: a volume of two works, Alfraganus's Latin text (dedication, prooemium, 32 chapters, scholia and appendix) and M. Iacobus Christmannus's commentary on the first chapter (calendars and chronological tables), followed by an index and errata.
